speed_settings.title: Speed settings
speed_settings.sub_text:
Enter speed number between 0.1 and 10
The speed setting will only affect the time interval between actions,
this will not affect other settings that are time related.
speed_settings.error_new_value: Your speed value must be between 0.1 and 10!

repeat_settings.title: Repeat settings
repeat_settings.error_new_value: You cannot have less than 1 repetition.

delay_settings.title: Delay settings
delay_settings.error_new_value: You cannot have less than 0 delay.

randomized_delay_settings.title: Randomized delay settings
randomized_delay_settings.sub_text:
Configure randomized delay bounds between actions in milliseconds.
Values below zero will allow for decreased time to next action.
Values above zero will allow for increased time to next action.
randomized_delay_settings.error_new_value: Both randomized delay bounds must be valid numbers.

distribution_drawer_settings.title: Distribution Editor
distribution_drawer_settings.distribution_instruction_text:
Draw the curve to represent how often each delay value is chosen.
Horizontal axis is the delay range; left is minimum, right is maximum.
Vertical axis is the relative frequency; higher values are chosen more often.
distribution_drawer_settings.help_instructions_text: Left-drag to draw • Drag a point vertically to move it • Right-drag to erase

vertical.tooltip_text:
Higher values mean that delay value is more common.
The vertical axis uses a constant linear scale.

horizontal.tooltip_text:
The X value is the randomized delay.
The horizontal axis uses a constant linear scale.

settings_information.interpolate_tooltip_text: Choose whether the curve uses sharp angles or smooth curves.
settings_information.interpolate_button_tooltip_text: Fill gaps in the current drawing using the selected interpolation type.
settings_information.clear_tooltip_text: Remove the entire curve. This is separate from right-drag erasing, which removes only the selected area.

freehand.note_text: Does not change the existing curve.

linear.description_text: Starts as a flat, uniform distribution in the middle of the drawing area.

bell.description_text: Starts as one or more bell shapes. Adjust the center, width, tail, and number of peaks.

controls.center_tooltip_text: Lower values move the bell left. Higher values move it right.
controls.width_tooltip_text: Lower values make the bell narrower and taller. Higher values make it wider and flatter.
controls.tail_magnitude_tooltip_text: 0 keeps the tails symmetrical. Higher values make the selected tail shorter and less pronounced.
controls.tail_side_tooltip_text: Choose which tail is adjusted. Left uses a negative sign; right uses a positive sign.
controls.peaks_tooltip_text: 0 creates a linear distribution. 1 creates one bell. Higher values create that many bells.
controls.reset_tooltip_text: Restore the default normal bell curve settings.
controls.apply_tooltip_text: Update the bell curve using the current settings.
